about_the_game:
About This Game


You’re a lucid dreamer, exploring the echoes of your own subconscious.
Navigate through procedural levels, interact with dynamic AI NPCs, and unravel a nested narrative that evolves, adapts, and molds itself around your player preferences, chosen avatars, and dream entries, revealing layer by layer the overarching storyline. It's a place where dreams have a story to tell, where the unpredictable gets a good laugh, and where the surreal blends with the real, opening up endless possibilities for exploration and discovery - but beware, you are not the only one! Ready to see where your dreams take you?

Gameplay


♦Create:
It starts with a dream. Your dream. Write down your dreams in your Journal, and watch as Lucid Echoes transforms them into a playground of possibilities, setting the stage for your adventure.

♦Explore:
Step into the game and wander through the surreal landscapes your dreams have crafted. Each dream generates a unique level, inviting you to dig deeper and laugh louder, where you'll find unexpected twists around every corner.

♦Unravel:
Engage with dynamic, AI-driven NPCs to solve dream conflicts, gather artifacts to gain special abilities, and unlock the deeper layers of the narrative. But watch out - nightmares have their place in this world too.

Features


  • Personalized Adventures: Your dream journal is the key. Each entry crafts a unique path in-game.
  • Procedural Generation: No two dreams are the same. The game unfolds fresh and unpredictable worlds.
  • Immersive Interaction: Dynamic AI-driven NPCs that react, adapt, and add.
  • Choice Matters: Your decisions have consequences and shape the storyline and the world around you.
  • Layered Narrative: A layered narrative that unfolds your avatar’s tale, the dream narrative, the overarching lore, and ultimately, your own story.
  • Vivid Visuals: A semi-realistic, first-person view blending surreal, vivid and psychedelic visuals into dreamlike environments.
  • Funny Unpredictability: Dreams have a mind of their own, expect the unexpected.
  • Moddable Gameplay: Customize your gameplay, share it with the community, and enjoy endless replay value as the game evolves with player-driven content.

Community Driven Development


We’re not just creating a game; we’re crafting a shared dream space.
At Liminal Game Studios, we believe in the power of community to shape the world of Lucid Echoes.
We’re creating a game that’s as much yours as it is ours. Your feedback isn't just welcomed; it's essential. It’s a collaborative journey where your insights and creativity fuel the ongoing evolution of the game.
From modding opportunities to active discussions on our community platforms to sharing what inspires you and what makes you laugh, we’re all about growing together.
So hop on, share your thoughts, crack a joke, tell us what inspires you, and be a part of the creative force driving Lucid Echoes forward.

Join the Community

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4GB or AMD Radeon RX 470 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred)
